summary: The proposed patch addresses the issue of inconsistent results between fit_predict and predict methods in GaussianMixture when n_init > 1. However, it lacks additional tests and documentation.

issues.description: The PR does not include new tests to verify the fix for the issue with n_init > 1. There should be additional unit tests added to ensure the consistency of fit_predict and predict methods.
The PR does not update the documentation to reflect the changes made. A comment or docstring should be added to explain why _set_parameters(best_params) is called before the final e-step.
